# truenas_iscsi_portal (Resource)

Manages an iSCSI portal on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_iscsi_portal" "main" {
  comment = "Default portal"
  listen = [
    {
      ip   = "0.0.0.0"
      port = 3260
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listen` (Attributes List) List of IP/port pairs the portal listens on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listen))

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the portal.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric iSCSI portal ID assigned by TrueNAS.
- `tag` (Number) Portal group tag assigned by TrueNAS.

<a id="nestedatt--listen"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listen`

Required:

- `ip` (String) IP address to listen on.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Port is reported by TrueNAS but cannot be set per-listen on TrueNAS 26.0+; the global iSCSI listen_port applies.
